audience: nonprofits and volunteers looking for work that is already done
title: Shared library
heading: Shared library
lead: Finished work from nonprofits’ requests, checked by volunteers and free for any nonprofit to use.

stored_lead: Tessera is the shared durable task queue and task objects store: every request is a few durable tasks (things to do) and task objects with their own ids. This is the list for {short}.

stored_rows.plan: The plan: how the request was split into parts
stored_rows.work: Part {n}: the work, for one volunteer's agent
stored_rows.review: Part {n}: the check, by a different volunteer
stored_rows.kit: Part {n}: the agent kit (a reusable process)
stored_rows.decisions: Your team's decisions, in your own space
